name: What bathroom remodeling questions should I ask during the first consultation?

mainEntity.name: What questions help reveal whether a bathroom contractor is a good fit before signing anything?
mainEntity.text: What questions help reveal whether a bathroom contractor is a good fit before signing anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first consultation is the best time to test both expertise and communication. Ask who will actually be on site, how the schedule is managed, and how the contractor handles permit-related work, waterproofing, and inspections. It also helps to ask what brands or product lines they commonly use, whether they provide detailed drawings, and how they price unforeseen issues. Good contractors explain the process clearly and do not overpromise on timing. If the answers are vague or inconsistent, that often signals trouble later. A strong consultation should leave the homeowner with a clear understanding of scope, budget range, and next steps rather than a generic sales pitch.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about timeline, permit handling, waterproofing methods, who will manage the job, how change orders work, and what happens if hidden damage is found. Also ask for examples of similar projects and whether the estimate is detailed or just a rough range.
